links.outcome: External validation performance on E-DAIC versus internal performance
links.effect: Internal accuracy 0.852-0.881 and F1 0.818-0.865; external accuracy 0.764-0.822 and F1 0.683-0.807, a moderate drop at the external site.
links.quote: In external validation, accuracy ranged from 0.764 to 0.822 and F1-score ranged from 0.683 to 0.807.

unlisted_practices: On-premises open-source LLM deployment for privacy preservation
Supervised fine-tuning versus zero-shot and chain-of-thought prompting
Multimodal integration of acoustic features with narrative text and clinical variables

screen.reason: The paper focuses on developing and benchmarking open-source multimodal LLMs for depression screening using text, tabular, and acoustic features on retrospective and public benchmark datasets. It does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
